mentions.name: Antigravity Telegram Bot Control Extension
mentions.description: A companion extension that lets the user control any chat agent in Antigravity from a Telegram bot, enabling remote interaction with coding agents.
mentions.problem: Replaces the human work of checking on agents by allowing remote control of Antigravity chat agents via Telegram.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a separate extension that lets me control any chat agent in ag from a telegram bot.
